snippet.title: Burger Bois - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Demo Launch Trailer for Burger Bois, a food truck simulator developed by Mischief Makers Studio. Players will adhere to the customers' requests to make the burger they've been looking for. Serve up flavor in Burger Bois, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on PC (Steam).
